test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under one of the provisions of Article 89 of the Indian Constitution, who shall be the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States?

options.text: The senior most member of the Council of States
The Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is__** The Vice-President of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under **Article 89 of the Indian Constitution**, it is provided that the **Vice-President of India** shall be the **ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha)**.
 
• This means that the **Vice-President automatically assumes the role of the Chairman** of the Rajya Sabha by virtue of holding the office of the Vice-President.
 
• The **Chairman presides over the sessions of the Rajya Sabha **and ensures its smooth functioning.
 
• However, **the Vice-President does not vote in the Rajya Sabha**, except in the case of a tie, where the Chairman exercises a casting vote.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 63 of the Indian Constitution tells that there shall be a Vice-President of India. 
 
• Articles 64 and 89 (1) tell that the Vice-President of India shall be the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States(Rajya Sabha).
 
• In the constitutional setup of India, the holder of the office of the Vice president is part of the executive but as the chairman of the Rajya Sabha, he is a part of Parliament. He has thus a dual capacity and holds two distinct and separate offices.
